description: Socioeconomic class derived from individual gross income brackets (table 06655, BruttoInn × Alder × Kjonn). Country median computed from bracket midpoints × counts; Eurostat AROP (0.60×) and OECD/Pew (1.00×, 2.00×) multipliers applied. Conditional on (age_group, sex).

poverty.description: Gross individual income < 0.60 × national median (Eurostat AROP threshold)

working_class.description: Gross individual income 0.60 – 1.00 × national median (OECD lower-middle floor)

middle_class.description: Gross individual income 1.00 – 2.00 × national median (OECD middle band)

wealthy.description: Gross individual income >= 2.00 × national median (OECD/Pew upper income)
